La feuille de Nehtelassë est frottée directement sur une blessure pour restaurer 1 à 6 points de vie. L'application demande d'avoir accès à la zone lésée, mais aucune décoction ni délai complexe n'est indiqué dans notre source. La plante se recherche dans les prairies fraîches du Nord-Ouest.

This leaf is found chiefly in cool temperate climates, especially in short-grass plains, and is best known in north-western Endor. Even in suitable terrain, it remains of medium difficulty to find.

A Nehtelassë leaf is rubbed directly onto a wound to restore 1–6 concussion hits. The injured area must be accessible, but the source specifies no decoction or complicated preparation. The plant may be sought in the cool grasslands of the North-west.
